name: Divine Inspiration
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level cleric/oracle 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range 100 ft.
Target allies of the same faith within a 100-ft. radius
Duration 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

All those within the spell’s area of effect who worship the same god as the caster receive a +4 luck bonus to attack, damage, saves, and skill checks for the spell’s duration.
